# git: alias: improve message for it

Give `git it` ([[DOT-30]]) a meaningful root-commit message. **Motivation:** "message `root` is useless." Suggestions: `init the repository` by default; `clone from template` when the repository is being re-initialised on top of a template (the `git scratch` scenario of [[DOT-172]]).
